newsitem.title: USA: NYC Comptroller Hevesi says will not run for mayor.
newsitem.headline: NYC Comptroller Hevesi says will not run for mayor.

text.p: New York City Comptroller Alan Hevesi said Monday he will not run for mayor and intends to run for re-election as comptroller instead.

Hevesi, who had been cited as a potential challenger to Mayor Rudolph Giuliani, said in a statement he decided to seek another term as comptroller because he still had "a great deal of work to do with some enormously important issues confronting us in 1997."
The comptroller also said personal reasons played a role.
"This is the wrong time for my family and me to run in a grueling, year-long mayoral campaign," he said.
